answer: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = 'TR001_19'
note: Atom identifier is ambiguous: atom_id suffix '_19' occurs in 219 different molecules, and the question gives no molecule to disambiguate. Chose TR001, the alphabetically-first molecule containing an atom numbered 19, as the most defensible single reading.

answer: SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n'
